meta.promptText: Which sarees should I buy online in India for a wedding on a budget?

response.text:
If you want a saree that looks rich and wedding-appropriate without spending a fortune, I’d focus on **Banarasi silk blends, Banarasi georgette, and zari-work sarees in the ₹1,000–₹3,000 range**\. You can find festive options online in India for much less, too. [hotdeals360.com](https://hotdeals360.com/fashion/wedding-guest-guide-elegant-ethnic-sets-and-sarees-under-3-000-10938544)[www.limeroad.com](https://www.limeroad.com/wedding-sarres-for-womens-under-3000)[www.pothys.com](https://www.pothys.com/collections/sarees-between-1000-3000)

## My top picks for a budget wedding saree

![Banarasi Silk Sarees for Weddings & Festive Occasions
 – Rangvarsha Sarees](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/jIHPDM7dR1CJC_c3pUcRsELurJ1CkXq_UUdZiPJPRwOV1iejMQ2HtyBGaSO5KABvxN1zSTyqKuqyEHKiHDBfHTpUbA1pJA2jwrn0jr8FpJu4sGlCW4KlIHw5mDmGWViFuTEikb6QFm_1_cST7I4AWBIqMN1AnPz8TXtGHLqqgYcG4TkUryyV7FAQ7q1ZMwm0?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Maroon or wine Banarasi semi-silk**

(Best overall)

Budget: ₹1,500–₹3,000

A classic choice for wedding ceremonies and evening functions. Gold zari borders and a contrasting blouse make it look festive without heavy embellishments.

[Shop Banarasee semi-silk sarees](https://banarasee.in/)

---

![Bottle Green Georgette Jaal Gold Zariwork Saree With Matching Blouse Piece | Koskii](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/op7eWh9RRk8BUA-RMUm7MVP5XUnPyk_JUh9ZgYoUOiQvdRu6LlKcK3TKKZUHTf4tFBZdt2tSRx_w-h7IuFQaJRsIh6S0vwRfZlZBo_9TVtkoMQWjJhLu-6bRBQj6CuxbDzIgcSXrC0wVz_kJBTCYP_G64CYwbA37RHw12wyJVwhaIOue3WU0daB6s8KdReQY?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Emerald green or royal blue georgette**

Budget: ₹800–₹2,000

Flowy, elegant and easier to manage than a heavy silk saree. Choose delicate embroidery, antique-gold zari or subtle sequins for a dressier finish.

[Browse wedding sarees on Myntra](https://www.myntra.com/sarees)

---

![Shop Pure Handloom Banarasi Tissue Silk Pink Golden Zari Border Saree
 – Sunasa](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/BHA4SXslcLPCoX2UUavMacFUzMRWAt3oBjVqdds04efYi9iVJu51CYyJWRaBV7mQH4QTln1jzSR6-rPYcWKyYWgqWdSsJqOUM2T81uEyofEyhvpc3Hma3BX6A-JQ3d2-fC1qo2HRo_j75C0Nf6xh-XRXgwhyNNoKE1YhJzhuxBg1D_TWbX7LmCjDrdX8jZwq?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Blush pink or rani pink tissue silk**

Budget: ₹1,000–₹2,500

Great for daytime weddings, engagement ceremonies and haldi functions. A gold-toned border adds a festive look without needing lots of jewellery.

[Browse budget wedding sarees on LimeRoad](https://www.limeroad.com/wedding-sarres-for-womens-under-3000)

---

![Shop Radiant Charm Wine Tissue Silk Zari Embroidered Sequins Saree Festive Wear Online at Best Price | Cbazaar](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/emn15WJJCHPnALXdg7zXYyo1fAh4G8pJnGiliPdr3i-nryKLjBwzvuL_q8jYeQvVE86Rr2DYtz4k4p7u5HRA_JahwQipOGXeOxO8PGQnoCDUbIYLS2sN5Y_HZyqpNJ5UjcLrM-Wk_n4qUB0uvVFaYNTsThqky_HZe5lnnj3pWp6S8Wst3UNt4T8aVhf6jwlb?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Satin or sequinned party-wear saree**

Budget: ₹700–₹1,800

Best for a reception or sangeet if you prefer a modern, glamorous look. Keep the jewellery simple and let the saree stand out.

[Browse wedding sarees on Flipkart](https://www.flipkart.com/clothing-and-accessories/sarees-and-saree-essentials/sarees/wedding~occasion/pr?sid=clo%2C8on%2Czpd)

## Specific sarees worth checking

These are concrete budget options surfaced in the shopping search. Prices can change with sales and availability.

Merchant: Banarasee

[View saree](https://banarasee.in/)

---



**KALINI Sequinned Poly Georgette Saree**

## ₹871

Merchant: Myntra

[View on Myntra](http://www.myntra.com/Sarees/KALINI/KALINI-Sequinned-Poly-Georgette-Saree/41584027/buy)

For more options, [browse Pothys sarees between ₹1,000 and ₹3,000](https://www.pothys.com/collections/sarees-between-1000-3000)\. The range includes soft silk, semi-silk and zari-work styles. [www.pothys.com](https://www.pothys.com/collections/sarees-between-1000-3000)

## How to get the best value

- **Check the fabric carefully\:** “Art silk” and “silk blend” are not the same as pure silk.
- **Look for an included blouse piece** so you don't spend more than planned.
- **Check customer photos and return conditions** before ordering.
- **Keep ₹500–₹1,000 aside** for blouse stitching and accessories if your budget allows.
